title: Company lifecycle, fraud and privacy
note: Synthetic data only. Registry and HR extracts are simulated files; IBANs use the invented bank code 9999/99999.

cases.purpose: Rename: the old name is kept and still matches

variants.label: event
variants.given: Request `corporate_event` (rename) for BP-900401 'Cifras Norte S.L.' (NIF B44730216) → 'Norte Analytics S.L.', registry extract attached, approved by the Finance Controller

expected.detail: Legal name changed; field history row old → new with the request as lineage; 'CIFRAS NORTE' kept as a former name; tax ID unchanged

variants.label: pass
variants.given: Delta CRM record 'Cifras Norte' (no tax ID, domain cifras-norte.example, ES) after the rename

expected.detail: M3 strong to BP-900401: similarity 1.0 against the former name, same domain and country. Without former names it would score 0.37 and become a new partner

variants.label: fail

variants.label: pass
variants.given: Request `corporate_event` (legal_form_change) approved: legal form SAS

expected.detail: V10 passes; SIREN and VAT number unchanged
